meta.title: Contact | ICUE Vietnam
meta.description: Write to ICUE Vietnam about a project, a tender, a role or a press request — one message, one desk, a reply inside 24 working hours.

instituteName: Institute of Construction Economics and Urban Planning

hero.title: Tell us about the project.
hero.lead: One form, four desks. Say what it is about and the message goes straight to the team that handles it — new work, a tender, a role, or a press deadline. Everything on the right is a way round the form, if you would rather not use it.

promise.body: Typical time to a first reply, counted in working hours. Something urgent on site is faster by phone.

skipForm.label: Or skip the form
skipForm.note: Reception — one hop to the right desk.

form.title: Write to us
form.lead: Four fields marked • are all we need. Everything else just helps us route it.

location.label: Where is it, and how far along?
location.placeholder: e.g. Hoà Bình — feasibility stage, tender in Q4

message.label: What do you need?
message.placeholder: Scope, site and timeline in three lines is plenty — we'll ask the rest.

form.consent: Send this to the desk below. We keep it to ourselves — no lists, no forwarding.
form.hintReady: Goes to {{desk}}. We'll confirm by email.

errors.name: We need a name to put on the reply.
errors.email: That address doesn't look right — we can't reply without it.
errors.message: Tell us what you need, even in one line.
errors.consent: Tick the box so we can pass this on.

success.title: Sent. Thank you.
success.body: It's with {{desk}} now. Expect a reply from a person, usually inside 24 working hours.

failure.title: That didn't send.
failure.body: Something between here and our server dropped it. Your words are still in the form — send them as an email instead, or try again.

project.title: New work & projects
project.note: Front desk · routed the same day

careers.title: Careers
careers.note: People team · CVs read every Friday

office.line2: Trung Hoà, Cầu Giấy, Hà Nội
office.visitors: Do arrange a time in advance, so the right person is there to meet you.

chat.note: Both answered in office hours, by the front desk.
